# cTab Message Templates

`ghost_ctab_templates`

Report templates for cTab messaging, aligned to the Ghost's smart
cards. A CASEVAC template must always remain, because the messaging code keys
one message type to it.

<!-- generated below this line by tools/gen_addon_readmes.py - do not edit -->

## Requires

- `cba_xeh` _(external)_
- `ghost_main`

Carries `skipWhenMissingDependencies` - the PBO is skipped rather than breaking the load order when something above is absent.
